# Asset Credits & Licenses — RIFT WARDEN

**Current status: environment/UI art is now PRODUCTION art generated first-party via the OpenAI Images API (gpt-image-1); characters/enemies/FX are still procedural runtime art. All images are generated by this project (no third-party / no external license risk). Audio remains procedural. See "Integrated production art" below.**

## Integrated production art (in-game, OpenAI Images gpt-image-1)
First-party generated, no third-party rights. Prompts inherit `RiftWarden/Art/Style Bible.md`; each passed gate 0004 in-context. Generator: `scripts/forge-art.mjs`.

| Texture key | File | Used in | Gen date | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `armory-bg` | `generated/RW-ARMORY-BG-001-v1.png` | ArmoryScene backdrop (forge/vault) | 2026-07-03 | PASS ~9/10 |

| _(store art)_ | `generated/RW-CAPSULE-HERO-020-v1.png` | Steam header/hero capsule source (`store/`) | 2026-07-04 | PASS ~9/10 |

Every visual is generated at runtime in `game/src/scenes/BootScene.ts` (pixel maps + Phaser Graphics).
Every sound is synthesized at runtime in `game/src/systems/audio.ts` (Web Audio API). No audio files ship.

## Rules for adding external assets later
If a procedural placeholder is ever replaced with a real asset, it MUST be logged here first, and it MUST be free for commercial game use:
- **Allowed:** CC0 / Public Domain, or CC-BY (with attribution recorded below), or an explicit royalty-free game license.
- **Not allowed:** anything scraped from Patreon/YouTube/Google Images, "free for personal use only," or unlicensed.

### Good CC0 sources to pull from if needed
- Kenney.nl — CC0 game art/audio.
- OpenGameArt.org — filter by CC0 / CC-BY.
- freesound.org — check each sound's individual license (mix of CC0 / CC-BY).
- incompetech.com (Kevin MacLeod) — CC-BY music (attribution required → record it here).
